headline: Football Kenya Federation Ousts Vice President In Meru Meeting
metaDescription: Football Kenya Federation vice president MacDonald Mariga and six other committee members were removed from their roles during a meeting in Meru.
aiSummaryBullets: Football Kenya Federation (FKF) vice president MacDonald Mariga was removed from office.
The decision to expel Mariga and six other National Executive Committee members was unanimous.
The meeting in Meru took place amid a heavy police presence.
aiContextParagraph: The Football Kenya Federation (FKF) conducted a Special General Meeting in Meru that resulted in the removal of multiple leadership figures. Among those dismissed was vice president MacDonald Mariga, who served alongside six other members of the National Executive Committee. According to reporting from local media, the meeting was characterized by tension and required a significant deployment of police officers to maintain order. Reports suggest that internal discord had developed between Mariga and the federation's president, Hussein Mohammed, following the conclusion of the 2025 CHAN finals held in Nairobi. The expulsion of these committee members marks a significant shift in the administrative composition of the organization. As of now, the federation has not provided additional details regarding the formal administrative procedures leading to the vote, though the removal of the seven officials was officially confirmed following the proceedings.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained visibility through multiple independent media outlets and a sudden shift in high-level sports leadership, resulting in a moderate viral activity score.
